caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame consisting of four turned legs and rectangular panels forming the headboard and footboard, all rendered in shades of light to medium brown. The frame is shown without a mattress, exposing the structure. The construction uses thick side rails connecting the legs, and the wood grain and joinery are clearly visible. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a detailed inset showing a close-up of the edge of the bed frame; this close-up displays a laced rope system arranged in a grid pattern, which would provide support for a mattress. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color, devoid of other objects or decorations.
title: Wooden Bed
